name: Odomos Blue 50gm Naturals Mosquito Repellent Non-Sticky Cream with Vitamin E & Almond Oil | Made in India
description:
Product Name: Odomos Blue Naturals Mosquito Repellent Cream
Weight: 50gm
Made in: India
Formulation: Non-sticky cream with Vitamin E & Almond Oil

Key Features & Benefits

Safe & Natural Protection: Unlike chemical repellents, Odomos doesn’t kill mosquitoes with harmful toxins but instead masks human body odour, making you virtually invisible to mosquitoes.

Clinically Proven: Certified by independent institutes as one of the most effective protectors against mosquito bites for up to 8 hours.

Enriched with Vitamin E & Almond Oil: Nourishes and protects the skin while keeping mosquitoes away.

Protection Against Diseases: Helps safeguard from mosquito-borne illnesses like Dengue, Chikungunya, Malaria, Filaria, and Encephalitis.

Day & Night Protection: Specially effective against daytime mosquitoes (like Aedes aegypti) which spread Dengue and Chikungunya.

Non-Sticky Formula: Gentle, skin-friendly, and comfortable for everyday use.
